title: 第005章 兄友弟恭
content_zh:
老先生淡定的摇了摇头。
刘如意忍不住的大笑了起来，他叫道：“长，你就在这里好好读书吧，我们几个做哥哥的一定会好好看着你，若是你再任意妄为，我们会将太子请过来的！”
“与你何关？！”
“当然有关，你就这个样子去当王，苦的是你治理下的百姓，是大汉百姓，我们每一个人都有资格让你成为一个合格的诸侯王！”
“呵，你放心，绝对比你强！”
“强在哪里？就你这样子，我看你封王之后肯定会去抢百姓家的耕牛去吃！”
“你想打架是不是？？”
在言语交锋中占据劣势的刘长勃然大怒（naoxiuchengnu），猛地站起身来，就要去跟刘如意讲“道理”，我不敢打太子还打不了你？打架是刘长唯一的优势，虽然年纪小，个头也小，但是刘长力气很大，寻常孩子根本打不过他。
历史上，这位刘长也是身材魁梧，性格勇猛，力能抗鼎，他真的举过鼎，某位不愿意透露姓名的霸王直呼内行。
还是刘恢急忙站出来，拦住了刘长，他胖胖的脸上满是无奈，“好了，长，别胡闹了，坐下来吧。”
直到老先生清了清嗓子，刘长才不情不愿的坐了下来，老先生继续开始讲课，刘如意笑吟吟的看着刘长，他就喜欢看弟弟想打死自己却无法动手的样子。
我那愚蠢的欧豆豆哦。
当课程结束的时候，为了防止刘长胡闹，那几个宦官直接将刘长围在中间，带着他准备回去，刘长恶狠狠的瞪了刘如意一眼，无奈的被包裹着离开，刘如意再次放声大笑。
当刘长憋着火，走进了椒房殿的时候，吕后这里却有客人。
能在这个时间来拜见吕后的人，身份自然不同，他是吕释之，也就是吕后的哥哥，他跟大哥吕泽曾为刘邦的统一事业做出过大贡献，也立下不少的军功，被封为建成侯。
他本来正在跟吕后低声说着些什么，看到刘长之后，他立刻就停了下来，一言不发。
吕后上下打量着刘长，说道：“不错，没有打架。”
刘长抚摸着圆滚滚的小肚子，叫道：“阿母..我饿。”
“我这里有事，自己去找宫女弄点吃的。”
“嗯。”

在刘长离开后，吕释之这才笑着说道：“这厮活得倒是滋润。”
“他没有收？”
“没收...他再也不肯见我了...也怪我，上次我把他得罪狠了，剑都快要摆在他脖子上了。”
“没事，目的达到了，以后你也不要再找他了。”
“那丞相那里？”
“我自有打算。”
“嗯。”
等到刘长啃着肉，哼哼唧唧的再度返回时，吕释之已经离开了，而椒房殿却变得有些热闹，好几个宫女围绕着一台大机器，刘长刚才进来的时候，这东西分明还不存在，显然是在他离开之后被抬进来的。
吕后为人严厉，因此宫女们虽然好奇，却不敢交谈议论。
“哇！”
刘长在看到机器的那一刻，来自刘常的记忆迅速占据了上风，他急忙冲到了机器面前，认真的打量了起来，这台机器的外观，其实就是在一个固定的木板上放了一个绳轮，这明显是一台手摇式的纺车。
那一刻，刘长有些看懵了，他来到这个时代也不算太久，这是他第一次看到了属于这个时代的工业机械。虽然很原始，通体都是木制的，可正是这样原始的机械，却在刘长眼里更加的迷人。
“这是纺织机？”
“这是谁做出来的？？”
刘长急忙询问道。
吕后有些惊讶，她没想到，刘长居然能认出这东西，她平静的说道：“我很小的时候就有了。”
“那肯定就是墨家做出来的呗！”
吕后对此不可置否，很是高冷的没有发表意见。
“阿母你怎么弄了台纺织机过来啊？”
“打发时日。”

吕后是懂得如何操纵这台机器的，在吕后操作机器的时候，刘长一动不动的坐在一旁，极其认真的看着这台古代机器，他本以为，穿越到这个时代，自己基本上是跟专业绝缘了，再也没有可能去施展什么才能了。
可是，面前这台机器，却用事实告诉他，这并非是一个蛮荒的与机械无缘的时代。
吕后额头留下了几滴汗水，这机器的确是比人工要方便的多，但是，毕竟还是要手摇操作，累肯定是很累的。
刘长几次凑过去想要帮忙，却都被吕后一把抓住脑袋，无情的推开了。
因此，刘长也就只能帮着擦擦汗什么的。
吕后用这台机器做什么，刘长心知肚明，他身上的每一件衣裳，都是吕后亲手给他织的...眼看气候逐渐寒冷，阿母这是要给他做过冬的衣裳，他这个年纪，一年一个身高，原先的衣裳大多都不合身了。
刘长傻笑着，坐在吕后的身边，用头蹭着她的胳膊，就是想要操作一下那台机器。
到最后，吕后方才答应他，只要接下来的一个月里，刘长不惹出任何麻烦，纺车就可以借给他玩。
作为启蒙教材，《仓颉篇》的确是难了一些。
可能李斯在创作的时候高估了未来的老师和学生们的水平，又或许是他低估了自己的才学。
反正，在汉初，作为启蒙教材的《仓颉篇》，在大汉引发了无数的混乱，主要的混乱就是讲解问题，不同的老师来讲解仓颉篇，每个人都能得到不同的回答，在皇宫里还好，可是在地方上，那些能力不足的老师，就容易胡说八道，误人子弟。
李斯并没有按着写启蒙教材的办法来写仓颉篇，他在仓颉篇里大量的运用了自己的思想精华，这简直就是启蒙孩童的终身心理阴影，本来因为可以认字而开开心心的孩子们，第一次读书，就接触到了李斯这个级别的人物写出来的思想大作。
这该有多崩溃啊？
所以，仓颉篇失传了...
这也是让刘长感到痛苦的一件事了，识文断字，这没有问题，可是讲解李斯的法家精神，这就有点太硬核了，我国古代的文人们有个不好的毛病，就是喜欢将简单的东西复杂化。
一本简简单单的春秋，后世都能弄成无数个版本，无数个含义，加上无数个注释，变得越来越厚，越来越深奥，越来越听不懂，到最后，同派家族居然看不懂彼此的家传春秋，打的你死我活...
刘长在前世，就非常的痛恨
刘长来这里上课也有一段时间了，在这段时日里，老大哥刘盈又来看望了他两次，每次前来都说了大概一个多时辰的道理，刘长强忍着没有动手，他答应过阿母，不能再惹祸的，否则，那台纺车就没了。
至于刘如意，则是一直都没有停止挑衅，每天都是笑吟吟的看着他，似乎在问他：怎么怂了？怎么不敢动手了？
刘恢还是一如既往的友好，还主动提出要给刘长补课，被刘长给拒绝了。

至于刘恒嘛...整天板着脸，跟吕后一模一样，刘长就不爱搭理他。你又不是太子，诸侯王神气什么？
是不是少说了一个人？额，好像没有了。
坐在天禄阁，又熬过了一个痛苦的课程，趁着先生休息的时候，刘长终于是凑到了刘恢的身边，他问道：“兄长，听说阿父要设宴了？是不是真的啊？”
“我不知道啊...”
“是要开宴了，怎么，你又想要过去偷肉吃啊？”
刘如意贱兮兮的问道。
刘长没有理会他，继续对刘恢说道：“兄长啊...我有事想要你帮忙，稍后你等我一下行吗？”
刘恢有些惊讶，他从来没有见过刘长这么恭敬的样子，他点了点头，答应了。
一旁的刘如意凑过来了一些，好奇的问道：“什么事啊？叫声兄长，我也可以帮你啊。”
“呵呵。”
刘长白了他一眼。
“你喊他们都是兄长，为什么到我这就成了如意？”
看到刘长还是不理会自己，刘如意愤愤不平，自怨自艾，嘀咕着些“弟不恭”之类的难懂的话。
content_en:
The old gentleman calmly shook his head.
Liu Ruyi couldn't help laughing, and shouted: "Chief, you can study hard here. We brothers will definitely watch you carefully. If you act arbitrarily again, we will invite the prince here!"
"What does it have to do with you?!"
"Of course it's relevant. If you become a king like this, the people under your rule will suffer, the people of the Han Dynasty. Each of us is qualified to make you a qualified vassal king!"
"Ha, don't worry, I'm definitely better than you!"
"What's so strong about you? If you look like this, I think you will definitely rob people's cattle to eat after you become king!"
"You want to fight, don't you??"
Liu Chang, who was at a disadvantage in the verbal confrontation, was furious (naoxiuchengnu), stood up suddenly, and was about to explain "reason" to Liu Ruyi, I don't dare to hit the prince, but I can't hit you? Fighting is Liu Chang's only advantage. Although he is young and small, Liu Chang is very strong and ordinary children cannot beat him.
Historically, this Liu Chang was also tall, brave, and capable of withstanding the tripod. He actually lifted the tripod, and a certain overlord who did not want to be named called him an expert.
Liu Hui stood up hurriedly and stopped Liu Chang. His fat face was full of helplessness, "Okay, Chang, stop fooling around and sit down."
It wasn't until the old man cleared his throat that Liu Chang reluctantly sat down. The old man continued to lecture. Liu Ruyi looked at Liu Chang with a smile. He liked to see his brother trying to beat him to death but couldn't do it.
My stupid Oudou.
When the class was over, in order to prevent Liu Chang from misbehaving, the eunuchs directly surrounded Liu Chang in the middle and took him back to prepare. Liu Chang glared at Liu Ruyi viciously, and was helplessly wrapped up and left. Liu Ruyi laughed loudly again.
When Liu Chang suppressed his anger and walked into Jiaofang Hall, Queen Lu had guests here.
The person who could come to see Empress Lu at this time had a different identity. He was Lu Shizhi, Empress Lu's brother. He and his eldest brother Lu Ze had made great contributions to Liu Bang's unification cause and had made many military exploits, so they were named Jianchou.
He was whispering something to Empress Lu, but when he saw Liu Chang, he immediately stopped without saying a word.
Empress Lu looked Liu Chang up and down and said, "That's right, there was no fight."
Liu Chang stroked his round belly and shouted, "Mom... I'm hungry."
"I have something to do here. I'll go find the palace maid and get some food."
"Yeah."
After Liu Chang left, Lu Shizhi smiled and said, "This guy is living a happy life."
"He didn't accept it?"
"Confiscated... He never wants to see me again... It's also my fault. I offended him so badly last time that the sword was almost on his neck."
"It's okay. The purpose has been achieved. Don't look for him again in the future."
"Where is the Prime Minister?"
"I have my own plans."
"Yeah."
When Liu Chang gnawed the meat and came back again grunting, Lu Shizhi had already left, but the Jiaofang Palace had become a little lively. Several palace maids were surrounding a large machine. When Liu Chang came in just now, this thing clearly didn't exist yet. It was obviously brought in after he left.
Empress Lu was a strict person, so although the ladies in court were curious, they did not dare to talk and discuss.
"Wow!"
The moment Liu Chang saw the machine, Liu Chang's memory quickly took over. He rushed to the machine and looked at it carefully. The appearance of the machine was actually a rope pulley placed on a fixed wooden board. It was obviously a hand-operated spinning wheel.
At that moment, Liu Chang was a little confused. He had not been in this era for too long. This was the first time he saw the industrial machinery of this era. Although it is very primitive and the whole body is made of wood, it is such primitive machinery that is more important in Liu Chang's eyes.Extra charming.
"Is this a loom?"
"Who made this??"
Liu Chang asked hurriedly.
Queen Lu was a little surprised. She didn't expect that Liu Chang could actually recognize this thing. She said calmly: "I had it when I was very young."
"That must have been made by the Mo family!"
Empress Lu could not deny this, and was very cold and did not express an opinion.
"Mom, why did you bring a textile machine over?"
"To pass the time."
Empress Lu knew how to operate this machine. When Empress Lu was operating the machine, Liu Chang sat motionless and looked at the ancient machine extremely seriously. He originally thought that after traveling to this era, he was basically insulated from the profession and would never be able to display his talents.
However, the machine in front of him told him with facts that this was not a barbaric era with no connection with machinery.
There were a few drops of sweat on Empress Lu's forehead. This machine was indeed much more convenient than manual work, but after all, it still had to be operated by hand, so it would definitely be very tiring.
Liu Chang approached several times to help, but Empress Lu grabbed her head and pushed her away mercilessly.
Therefore, Liu Chang could only help wipe away the sweat.
Liu Chang knew exactly what Empress Lu was doing with this machine. Every piece of clothing he wore was knitted by Empress Lu herself... Seeing that the weather was getting colder, his mother wanted to make him winter clothes. At his age, he was getting taller every year, and most of the original clothes no longer fit.
Liu Chang smiled silly, sat next to Queen Lu, and rubbed his head on her arm, just wanting to operate the machine.
In the end, Lu Fang agreed to lend him the spinning wheel as long as Liu Chang did not cause any trouble in the next month.
As an enlightenment textbook, "Cangjie Pian" is indeed a bit difficult.
Maybe Li Si overestimated the level of his future teachers and students when he was creating, or maybe he underestimated his own talent.
Anyway, in the early Han Dynasty, the "Cangjie Pian" as an enlightenment textbook caused countless confusions in the Han Dynasty. The main confusion was the explanation problem. Different teachers explained the Cangjie Pian, and everyone could get different answers. It was fine in the palace, but in the local area, those teachers with insufficient ability could easily talk nonsense and mislead the students.
Li Si did not write the Cangjie Chapter according to the method of writing enlightenment textbooks. He used a lot of the essence of his own thoughts in the Cangjie Chapter. This is simply a lifelong psychological shadow of enlightenment children. Children who were originally happy because they could read read, for the first time, they were exposed to the ideological masterpieces written by people of Li Si's level.
How devastating would this be?
Therefore, the Cangjie chapter was lost...
This is also something that makes Liu Chang feel painful. There is no problem in being able to read and write, but explaining Li Si's Legalist spirit is a bit too hard-core. Ancient Chinese literati had a bad habit, that is, they like to complicate simple things.
A simple Spring and Autumn Annals can be made into countless versions by later generations, with countless meanings, and countless annotations. It becomes thicker, more profound, and increasingly incomprehensible. In the end, families from the same sect cannot understand each other's family traditions of the Spring and Autumn Period, and they fight to the death...
In his previous life, Liu Chang hated him very much.
Liu Chang has been attending classes here for some time. During this period, his eldest brother Liu Ying came to visit him twice. Each time he came to talk to him for more than an hour. Liu Chang resisted and did not take action. He promised his mother not to cause trouble again, otherwise, the spinning wheel would be gone.
As for Liu Ruyi, she never stopped provoking. She looked at him with a smile every day, as if asking him: Why are you so timid? Why don't you dare to take action?
Liu Hui was as friendly as ever, and even offered to give Liu Chang extra lessons, but Liu Chang refused.
As for Liu Heng?...he kept a straight face all day long, just like Empress Lu, so Liu Chang didn't like to talk to him. You are not a prince, why are the princes and kings so proud?
Is there one less person to talk about? Well, it seems there is no more.
Sitting in Tianlu Pavilion, after another painful class, Liu Chang finally came to Liu Hui's side while his husband was resting. He asked: "Brother, I heard that my father is going to hold a banquet? Is it true?"
"I don't know..."
"A banquet is about to take place. What, you want to go over and steal meat again?"
Liu Ruyi asked coquettishly.
Liu Chang ignored him and continued to say to Liu Hui: "Brother... I need your help with something. Can you wait for me later?"
Liu Hui was a little surprised. He had never seen Liu Chang look so respectful. He nodded and agreed.
Liu Ruyi on the side came closer and asked curiously: "What's going on? Call me brother, I can help you too."
"Haha."
Liu Chang rolled his eyes at him.
"You call them all brothers, why do they become Ruyi when it comes to me?"
Seeing that Liu Chang still ignored her, Liu Ruyi was indignant, felt sorry for herself, and muttered some difficult words such as "disrespectful brother".
